original_query: Do most buyers type the URL address directly into Internet or use a search engine every visit?

confirmed.answer_text: Most buyers type the URL address directly into the Internet, with 55% doing so, compared to 42% who searched on the Internet.
cited_statements: 55% Typed web address directly into Internet
Only 21% used a search engine every time before visiting the site
